park_hierarchy.title: The Geometry of Categorical and Hierarchical Concepts in Large Language Models
park_hierarchy.location: Figure 1; Theorem 8; Appendix F, Figures 10 and 12
park_hierarchy.evidence: A formalization of hierarchical orthogonality, with empirical tests of concept-vector differences in whitened softmax spaces.
park_hierarchy.construction: Four-level organism/animal/mammal/dog chain with plant, bird, and cat siblings. A three-dimensional schematic shows the highlighted chain's three orthogonal increments.
park_hierarchy.metric: Causal inner product, estimated through whitening of unembeddings.

hernandez_relations.title: Linearity of Relation Decoding in Transformer Language Models
hernandez_relations.evidence: Relation-specific affine maps recover subject--object mappings for most test subjects for nearly half of 47 evaluated relations.
hernandez_relations.construction: Miles Davis/trumpet follows the paper; Yo-Yo Ma/cello is an additional illustrative pair. Positions and arrows are schematic.
